description: This file defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API module. It represents a data model for employee leave entitlement details, including employee information and entitlement calculations. The class implements serialization and constructor argument awareness, and provides a method to serialize its data into an array.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A model class representing employee leave entitlement information, capable of converting its data into an array format for serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel with employee details, a list of entitlement records, and optional entitlement value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the employee leave entitlement data into an associative array, calculating current entitlement based on entitlement records.
